subject: Parking Program Modifications and Long-Term Stabilization Fund
overview: The Council approved the establishment of a municipal stabilization fund for major infrastructure projects and debated extensive modifications to the city's new pay-to-park program. They also moved forward with license approvals, a taxi company audit, and a resolution opposing utility rate increases.

items.title: Long-Term Stabilization Fund
items.summary: Approved a resolution to establish a municipal stabilization fund for future major projects, referring the matter to the Committee of the Whole for further planning.

items.title: Simple Fare Delicatessen License
items.summary: Granted a common victualler license to Michael Del Signore for Simple Fare Delicatessen at 460 High Street.

items.title: Pay-to-Park Program Modifications
items.summary: Continued the discussion regarding implementation issues with the pay-to-park program and referred proposed modifications, including extended time limits and convenience fee waivers, to the Committee of the Whole.

items.title: Council Appointment Vetting
items.summary: Approved a request for a list of positions under council purview to develop job descriptions and improved vetting procedures.

items.title: Ceremonial Recognitions
items.summary: Passed resolutions congratulating Tree Warden Aggie Tudin for her industry award and Congresswoman Katherine Clark for her appointment as assistant minority whip.

items.title: Taxicab Company Audit
items.summary: Approved an audit of all licensed taxicab companies in the city to verify compliance with local ordinances.

items.title: Condolences for Jack Downs
items.summary: Offered condolences and observed a moment of silence for former teacher and golf coach Jack Downs.

items.title: Salem Street Parking Lot Maintenance
items.summary: Directed letters to the property owner, code enforcement, and the Board of Health regarding the blighted condition of the Stop and Shop parking lot.

items.title: NSTAR Utility Rate Increase Opposition
items.summary: Approved a resolution opposing proposed NSTAR gas and electric rate increases, with the clerk directed to notify the Department of Public Utilities and the federal delegation.

items.title: Tufts University Property Acquisition Inquiry
items.summary: Requested an update from the Office of Community Development regarding a bond request and property acquisition by Tufts University at 119 College Avenue.
